## Page 2

Executive Summary
•Various  events throughout Y2025 that negatively affected the spending sentiment of the Group’s target customers 
•TAN can report Y2025 Revenue Growth +7% and delivered Net Profit 46.2 MB.
•Profit declined YoY: 
•Domestic revenue growing at a slower pace than the target under a weakening economic environment
•Higher  expenses incurred during the initial phase of business expansion to support long -term growth both domestically and overseas. 
•The increase in expenses was primarily driven by overseas operations , as well as the higher proportion of expenses from investments 
made over the past year in gradually expanding branches (including employee costs, rental expenses, and depreciation).
•One-time accounting adjustments arising from accounting standard improvements and audit adjustments , mainly related to the food 
and beverage business in the amount of 23.4 million Baht and overseas operations in the amount of 13.1 million Baht. 
•The accounting standard improvements and audit adjustments recognized during 2024 and 2025 were mainly associated with newly 
established businesses .
•As the accounting records become fully standardized, the Company expects such accounting adjustments to significantly decrease in 
2026.
•The total one -time accounting adjustments recorded in Q4 2025 amounted to Baht 42.2 million. When combined with the reported 
net profit of Baht 5 million, the normalized net profit from operations would be approximately Baht 47 million, which is at a  level 
close to that of Q4 2024.

General & Administrative Expense Q4 & Y2025
•G&A Expense in Q 4 2025 included:
•Increased number of employees accumulated from year 2024 at head -office to support organization growth

## Page 20

Net Profit Q 4 & Y2025
•Net Profit (Company) in Q 4 2025 5.0 MB
•Overseas revenue growth YoY; but necessary to have selling and administrative expenses in each country that are balanced with  income
•Growth for Domestic revenue YoY → helped support the losses in the early stages of overseas operations
•One-time adjustments (accounting standard improvements and audit adjustments), F&B business 23.4 MB and overseas operations 13.1 MB. 
•Excluding these one -time items (total 42 MB), normalized net profit from operations for Q 4 2025 would have been approximately Baht 47 
million, representing around 9% of total revenue.
•Net Profit (Company) in Y2025 lower vs last year:
•Overseas revenues increased, selling and marketing expenses increased at a 
higher rate than sales growth in the short term.
•Unavoidable to take time to start a new business abroad
•However, China & Japan  business turnaround from loss to profit.
•Administrative expenses increased to support future growth of the business 
locally and internationally.
•Excluding all one -time accounting adjustments recognized during 2025, 
normalized net profit from operations for the year would have been 
approximately Baht 93 million, representing around 5% of total revenue.
•The Group intends to build a larger business base to support future 
growth of the new business locally and internationally in the long term.

## Page 25

Outlook 2026
•Strong emphasis on disciplined capital expenditure  for expansion, further reductions of unnecessary costs , and 
prioritizing the non -renewal and/or closure of underperforming branches
•Restoring profitability to a normalized level on a consistent quarterly basis, together with the absence of large one -
time accounting adjustments concentrated in a single quarter, as experienced in 2024 and 2025.
•In terms of sales performance: focus primarily on improving same -store sales . 
•With respect to overseas operations , which remain in their early stage of development, accounting standards 
aligned with Thailand throughout 2024 and 2025. Not expecting similar one -time accounting adjustments. Monthly 
revenue growth should become more stable as brand -building efforts continue.
•For Digital Transformation : implement a new POS system across all operations in Q2 and deploy the ERP system 
SAP S/4HANA in Q4. → enhance data accuracy, strengthen operational capabilities, and better equip all business 
units to address operational challenges effectively
•Introduce one additional brand  in 2026. The overall brand management strategy will focus primarily on delivering 
strong value -for-money propositions to target customers, in alignment with the current economic slowdown and the 
near-term outlook.
